label: Lactitol
note: Poorly absorbed: about 2-2.5 kcal/g and 30-40 % of the sweetness of sugar.

about.text: Lactitol is a disaccharide sugar alcohol produced from lactose. It is a bulk sweetener (E966) in sugar-free sweets, biscuits, chocolate and ice cream, and an osmotic laxative.
